visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A CGI-rendered anthropomorphic bulldog, wearing a khaki bucket hat, white tank top, and green athletic shorts, sits on a colorful red and blue mechanical rocking horse outside a store. The background features parked scooters and glass store windows displaying signs with Traditional Chinese characters. The lighting is bright and natural, casting soft shadows on the concrete sidewalk. (2) The bulldog's mouth opens wide in a silent, exaggerated roar just as a bright orange explosion erupts from beneath the mechanical horse. Thick grey smoke and orange sparks fill the center of the frame, momentarily obscuring the character and the toy. The background remains static and unaffected by the digital blast. (3) The bulldog character is now lying motionless on the asphalt road in a face-down position. Above him, the mechanical horse toy is propelled into the air, spinning rapidly while trailing a plume of dark smoke. The scene maintains its static eye-level perspective, focusing on the surreal aftermath of the explosion in an urban setting.

(2) A sharp, intense explosion sound effect occurs, characterized by a sudden percussive peak and a broad frequency spectrum. This transient sound effect momentarily masks the background music, creating a high-arousal acoustic event. The sound has a short decay, simulating a quick, violent burst or impact in an otherwise quiet space. (3) After the explosion, the cheerful children's BGM resumes its steady, major-mode progression. The female vocal continues with the same bright tone and fast speech rate. There is a lack of incidental noise from the falling objects, keeping the focus entirely on the contrast between the happy music and the chaotic visual.
